name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. The SDK was installed, the example script was created and executed, and a valid MP3 audio file (41KB, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz) was generated from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." The file is saved at /home/daytona/output.mp3.
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers. Since this is a headless sandbox without audio playback capability, I substituted `save(audio, "/home/daytona/output.mp3")` to save the generated audio to a file instead. This is the only deviation — all other steps (installing the SDK, loading the API key from environment, using the same voice_id, model_id, output_format, and text) followed the quickstart exactly.

configured.evidence: python example.py ... exit=0 ... Audio saved to /home/daytona/output.mp3 (the script requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY and would fail without it)
